summary: Monterey County AWS site on Mount Toro: FFLA lists it gone under non-wildland lookouts; no build, staffing or fire history in the sources read.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it gone under Non-Wildland Lookouts as an AWS; peakbagging labels the same site an LO site (building removed)

evidence.supports: FFLA lists Toro, Mount AWS as gone, with coordinates in Monterey County
evidence.quote: Toro, Mount AWS Monterey 36.52571 -121.60987 AWS Gone

evidence.supports: FFLA files the site under a Non-Wildland Lookouts section
Kemnow catalogue page for the site has only the heading MOUNT TORO AWS
definition of AWS as an automatic weather station
evidence.quote: An automatic weather station ( AWS ) is an automated version of the traditional weather station

evidence.supports: AWS used to save human labor or enable measurements from remote areas
evidence.quote: either to save human labor or to enable measurements from remote areas

evidence.supports: peak table labels the site Mt Toro (LO site)
LO site means the building has been removed
evidence.quote: A (LO site) is where the building has been removed

evidence.supports: peak table row: Chualar map, Mt Toro (LO site), lookout elevation 3,564 ft (EL column)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLA lists the site as an AWS in its Non-Wildland Lookouts section; peakbagging lists the same site as a lookout site whose building has been removed. Not resolved; the story gives both labels and does not say what stood on the summit.

sources.title: Mount Toro AWS, Forest Lookouts (Ron Kemnow)

notes_for_editor: Very thin record. Kemnow's page has only a heading; FFLA gives coordinates, AWS type and gone status; peakbagging gives the 3,564 ft elevation, Chualar map and LO-site label. Peakbagging also lists the park/other land column as 'Private Land'; not verified and not used in the story. No build date, staffing or fire record found. The story is shorter than the usual 120-word floor because the sources have nothing more. The WebSearch calls for this site returned nothing useful; the AWS definition came from one extra Wikipedia read beyond the page budget. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the 3,564 ft figure is the lookout elevation (EL column), not the summit.
